Villagers fleeing — minifigs streaming down cobblestone lanes from the shadow overhead, arms flung wide, one sprawled mid-fall, a neighbor hauling them upright, the terror frozen across every printed face.

A crew battling the beast — sailor minifigs on the storm-tilted deck driving harpoons into the rising coils, one dragged toward the rail, the cannon's crew still loading, the desperate stand caught mid-swing.

A family in peril on the upper floors — minifig parents at the crumbling tower's highest window, the smallest child raised overhead toward a rescuer's outstretched C-hand, the drop below them real and close.

Heroes mid-rescue — a rescuer minifig leaning full over the gorge's edge, rope taut between clenched hands, the imperiled figure swinging free below, the breathless grab caught at its narrowest instant.

Scientists evacuating — lab-coat minifigs scrambling the corridor as the breach floods behind them, one arm-flat on the bulkhead control, a sample case abandoned mid-slide, the airlock gap closing fast.
Spectators recoiling — a crowd of onlooker minifigs blown backward from the detonation's edge, hats spinning, arms crossed over printed faces, the shockwave's human ring frozen in staggered retreat.

A lone hero facing the threat — a single small minifig planted at the dragon's foot, sword arm thrown forward, the enormous centerpiece rearing above, the David-and-Goliath instant held perfectly still.
A captain going down with the ship — a lone captain minifig locked to the helm as the black wave crests the bow, coat streaming, jaw set, the doomed resolve printed clear on a tiny face.
Children at a lit window — small minifigs pressed to the warm amber pane of the storm-lashed lighthouse cottage, noses to the glass, the candle glow behind them against the dark rage outside.

Guards holding the breach — soldier minifigs shoulder-locked in the shattered castle wall, shields driven forward, one knee-buckled and falling, the line bowing but not yet broken, the last-stand beat frozen.
A climber reaching the top — a minifig at the beanstalk's final rung, one hand just cresting the cloud's edge, legs still climbing, the summit and the giant's shadow arriving at the same instant.

A wizard casting against the danger — a robed minifig arms-wide at the cliff's rim, a trans-blue bolt arcing from raised hands toward the oncoming wave, the spell's cost visible in the backward-braced stance.
